title: HelloWorld
tagline: Decentralized and free content creators project for courses and others
description: This project was created with the idea of ​​having creators with a free platform, which allows them to take advantage of decentralized storage and a free platform to upload their content and market in the way they see fit, without censorship or limitations of that kind. They can upload their courses without limitation
how_its_made: This project has a front end in React, which has the connections to the contracts through Web3, Chakra is the framework that was used for the components, the contracts were built in solidity and everything was programmed to work with the testnet of filecoin Hyperspace, aditional the project have basic setup to deploy the project with IPFS
